name: localplugins
description: A community-built collection of Claude Code plugins — brand-forge, content-multiplier, green-keeper, money-map, and docpin. Most run entirely on your machine; docpin fetches version-matched library docs (always cited); brand-forge's AI imagery is opt-in.

plugins.name: content-multiplier
plugins.description: Turn one idea, post, or transcript into a week of on-brand content across every channel and language — no accounts, no API keys, no setup.

plugins.name: green-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps your tests and types green while you code — fixes red with minimal changes, maintains behavioral tests, and won't let you walk away from red. No fake-green.

plugins.name: money-map
plugins.description: Understand your money: hand it any bank or card CSV export and it categorizes, summarizes cash flow, and flags anomalies — locally, never linked to your accounts.

plugins.name: docpin
plugins.description: Ground Claude in docs matched to the library versions installed in your project (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go). Fetches from public registries on demand, always cited.

plugins.name: brand-forge
plugins.description: Generate on-brand logos, social templates, and marketing graphics — vector assets run locally with no accounts or keys; AI imagery is opt-in.
